questions.question: When people are engaged in production of goods and services they are said to be engaged in _______.
questions.solution:
Economic activities: Actions that involve the production, distribution,and consumption of goods and services at all levels within a society.

**Production of goods** is the production in economic activities and **providing services** is the distribution of service.

questions.question: For comparing the development of countries, what is considered to be one of the most important attributes?
questions.solution:
For comparing the development of countries, **__Income__** is considered to be one of the** most important attributes**.

 
• A country scores higher HDI(Human Development Index) if **income **per capita of the country is higher. 
 
• Developed countries have higher **income **per capita compared to developing countries.
 
• Usually, a **developed economy** is typical of a developed country with relatively high levels of economic growth and health.
 
• **Per capita, Gross Domestic Product (GDP)** is the most common measure used to determine whether an economy is developing or developing.

questions.question: What is the process of wearing away of the Earth’s surface called?
questions.solution:
• **Erosion** is a natural process which is usually made by rock and soil being loosened from the earth's surface at one location and moved to another.
 
• While in **deposition** sediments, soil and rocks are added to a landform or land mass.

questions.question: The _______ is a narrow zone where we find land, water, and air together which contains all forms of life.
questions.solution:
The **biosphere** is the global ecological system integrating all and their relationship.

It is a narrow zone of the earth where land (**lithosphere**), water(**Hydrosphere**) and air(**Atmosphere**) interact with each other to support life.

questions.question: Pancreas has ________.

options.text: only one type of cell, the same functioning both in an exocrine and endocrine fashion
two type of cells-exocrine and endocrine

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __two types of cells exocrine and endocrine__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The pancreas is a compound (both exocrine and endocrine) elongated organ situated between the limbs of the ‘C’ shaped duodenum.
 
• The pancreas has exocrine glands that produce enzymes that are useful for digestion.
 
• These are released from the acinar cells that act as exocrine cells.
 
• Trypsin, Chymotrypsin is the enzyme secreted by the pancreas that is useful to digest proteins.
 
• The amylase enzyme is useful for the digestion of carbohydrates.
 
• Lipase is used to break down fats.
 
• The endocrine cells are the cells of the Islet of Langerhans which secrete endocrine hormones like insulin and glucagon.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• It works as an **exocrine **when it secretes pancreatic juice.
 
• It works as an **endocrine **when it secretes hormones, insulin, or Glucagon to control blood sugar levels.
 
• 99% part of the pancreas is exocrine while only 1% part is endocrine

questions.question: The motions of a simple pendulum is an example of _________.

questions.question: What is the maximum age for joining National Pension Scheme?
questions.solution:
​The correct answer is __**70 Years**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The maximum age for joining National Pension Scheme is **70 years.**
 
• Senior citizens above age 65 (**up to 70 years**) are also allowed to open a **National Pension System (NPS) account**.
 
• A citizen of India, whether resident or non-resident can join **NPS (National Pension Scheme).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority:**

 
 
• It is the statutory authority established by an enactment of the Parliament, to regulate, promote and ensure orderly growth of the National Pension System (NPS).
 
• It works under the Department of** Financial Services** under the **Ministry of Finance.**
 
• **Functions:**
 
• It performs the function of appointing various intermediate agencies like Pension Fund Managers, Central Record Keeping Agency (CRA), etc.
 
• It develops, promotes, and regulates the pension industry under the NPS and also administers the APY.
 
 
 
• **National Pension Scheme**
 
• The National Pension Scheme (NPS) in India, regulated by the Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA), is a voluntary retirement savings initiative catering to employees from various sectors and self-employed individuals. It comprises two tiers: Tier I, a mandatory long-term retirement account, and Tier II, a voluntary savings account offering flexibility in withdrawals. NPS allows contributors to choose investment options such as equity, corporate bonds, and government securities. Tax benefits are available under Section 80C, and there's an additional benefit for employer contributions in the corporate sector. At the time of retirement, subscribers can utilize the accumulated corpus to purchase an annuity, ensuring a regular pension income. The NPS serves as a systematic and comprehensive platform for individuals to plan and secure their financial future post-retirement.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• **PFRDA has revised the guidelines on entry and exit and has increased the maximum age for joining the NPS from 65 years to 70 years of age**__.

questions.question: The Sendai Framework is related to _________.
questions.solution:
